evidence: The track begins on Kiwi Ranch Road. It climbs steadily towards Puffer Saddle, then reaches a turnoff with the Southern Crossing track. For a clockwise loop (described here), take this track.
The track emerges near Smith Creek Shelter, near the confluence of Smith Creek with the Tauwharenīkau River.
The track climbs out of Smith Creek valley to Puffer Saddle, then descends towards Kaitoke. It meets the turnoff with the Southern Crossing, then the track continues down to Kiwi Ranch Road.

evidence: ### Kaitoke Road End to Smith Creek Shelter via Puffer Saddle – returning back on the same track (13 km, 4 - 5.5 hours; walking track)
The track begins on Kiwi Ranch Road. It climbs steadily towards Puffer Saddle, passing a turnoff to the Southern Crossing on the way.
Return back to the road end the way you came, following the track up Smith Creek and over Puffer Saddle.

doubts: Main way chosen as the full loop because the page is named Dobson Loop Track; DOC's summary time (5.5 hr return to Smith Creek Shelter) is for the out-and-back option W2. On the loop, part of the Southern Crossing track is walked up to the old Dobson Hut site turnoff; I listed the Southern Crossing as other walk since only that section is used. Smith Creek Shelter is not said to have bunks, so it is not listed under huts. Marchant Creek has no matching entry (T4 is a peak).
